name: Timberling Sprout
summary: Timberling Sprouts are young, nascent plant elementals taking root near the shores of Lake Al'Ameth in Teldrassil. Even in their earliest growth, these sprouts show signs of corruption, prompting night elf wardens to pull them before they mature into aggressive timberlings.

sections.title: Blighted Seedlings
sections.body: Timberlings are plant spirits closely tied to the natural vitality of Teldrassil, but the seedlings sprouting along Lake Al'Ameth have worried the local night elves. Rather than emerging healthy and in harmony with the wild, they sprout already tainted and aggressive. Because these infant sprouts appear beyond cleansing or natural healing, caretakers at Lake Al'Ameth must gather and destroy them to prevent an uncontrolled spread of hostile timberlings across the fragile boughs of the newly planted World Tree.

faq.answer: Timberling Sprouts grow close to the water's edge along the shores of Lake Al'Ameth, south of Dolanaar in Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why are night elves pulling Timberling Sprouts from the ground?
faq.answer: The sprouts are sprouting tainted from the very beginning. Left unchecked, they grow into violent timberlings that threaten the safety and balance of Teldrassil. Because they are considered beyond help, the caretakers remove them while they are still small.

faq.q: What is causing the sprouts to become tainted?
faq.answer: A mysterious sickness has begun affecting the wildlife and plant elementals of Teldrassil. While the exact source of the taint is still an unsolved riddle to the botanist Denalan, it influences young timberlings from the moment they take root.

faq.q: Who asks for Timberling Sprouts to be collected?
faq.answer: Denalan, the botanist tending Lake Al'Ameth, asks adventurers to collect and clear the sprouts from the lakeside to keep the land pure.

angles.text: For druids attuned to the plant life and elementals of Kalimdor, seeing natural woodland spirits sprout pre-corrupted from the soil is a grim omen for Teldrassil's future.
Young night elves beginning their training in Shadowglen are tasked with clearing these sprouts to safeguard their new woodland home.
